From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>

Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-05-14T18:32:00Z
Subject: Re: production timeouts - EU - customer impact (triage notes)

Ben / team —

Triage update: our EU edge cluster is showing a sharp increase in front-end queue depth and downstream 504s to the gateway between 17:40-17:55 UTC. Indicators:
- Per-edge CPU utilization spike on proxy nodes servicing eu-west-1, concurrent connection counts +60% vs baseline.
- Retries from certain client agents have amplified; same client IPs issuing repeated requests (pattern suggests aggressive client retries without jitter).
- Backend serving nodes are healthy; per-model latency distributions haven't spiked proportionally, which points to proxy/backpressure.

Immediate mitigations I'm applying now (taking ~5m):
1) Apply a temporary per-IP connection cap and drop excessive concurrent connections on eu-edge proxies.
2) Enable a stricter ingress 429 rate-limit with a short 30s cooldown for offending clients.
3) Opened fallback routing to dedicated reserved pool in eu-dedicated-1 to offload critical HeliosPay traffic.

I also pulled a short trace bundle and attached edge counters + recent logs to the incident JIRA. We need Helios to confirm whether they can back off aggressive retry behavior on their side; I'll provide a recommended retry jitter window.

I'll keep this thread updated with metrics and whether the temporary caps reduce the 502/504 wave.

- Vivek
Principal SRE, Redwood Inference
